text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong urges local companies to consolidate their resources through strategic alliances then grow into the global arena.
- Singapore offers help in developing Vietnam's tourism indudstry.
- NTCU FiarPrice tries to get Singaporeans to give Myanmar rice a try, as an alternative to Thai rice.
- Integrated circuit designer Serial System Pte Ltd is ranked Singapore's most enterprising private local company for 1996.
- Annual Report Awards committee chairman Tan Chok Kian says finance and hotel companies as well as Sesdaq firms can do better in terms of presentation and disclosure.
- Long-suspended Malaysian Feedmills Ltd is to be revived with proposal from Lion Group of Malaysia having been approved in principle by the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
- Recently-listed IPOs draw frenzied trading from retail investors buoyed by positive sentiment.
- Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp's building subsidiary clinches construction management contract in India for U.S. $10 million.
- Police investigates two reports lodged by applicants of Fumakilla Bhd for mishandling of the public balloting of the shares.
